description: Check if you have winning shares to redeem in a resolved market. Pass the market's conditionId (from get_market response). If redeemable=true, returns transaction calldata that the owner wallet must submit on-chain to collect USDC winnings. Amounts are in USDC base units (6 decimals: 1000000 = $1).

conditionId.description: Market condition ID (0x...) — get this from the get_market response. Identifies which market's shares to check for redemption.

name: check_redeem
